values.note: KOA's booking form, 2 adults, a 23-ft motorhome, one night, before tax. Pull-through water/electric from $50 on 2027-05-18 and 2027-09-14, $63 on 2027-07-13; pull-through full hookup $58.88 then, $74.94 in July. The back-in type won't take a 23-ft motorhome on the form ('Perfect for a smaller Class C, pickup camper, pop-up or van').

hookups.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/augusta/reserve/ (site types 'Pull Thru, 50/30 Amps, Full Hookups') + https://koa.com/campgrounds/augusta/ ('50 Max Amp'), read 2026-11-02

note: KOA Journey at 30 Mallard Drive, Richmond. Pull-throughs are gravel pads terraced on a hillside. --Claude
summary: Fees changed 50-58.88 -> 50-74.94 after a July quote. Confirmed water, sewer, pull-through, operator booking. Added 50-amp, 80-ft max, season Apr 30-Oct 31, wifi. Price and rating dropped from the note.
flags: PRICE GATE: DROP CANDIDATE on the summer rate. Cheapest type a 23-ft motorhome can book: $50.00 on a May and a September 2027 Tuesday, exactly at the US$50 gate and not over it, but $63.00 on a July 2027 Tuesday. No gateway within 40 km (Acadia NP 132 km). The earlier read saw only the May quote. Good Sam: no match by name in the cached directory, so no GS Park 10% to apply. Whether the gate reads the cheapest shoulder night or the peak is AWH's call; this one passes only on the former.

PRIVATE GATE FACTS: Google 4.1 on 237 reviews, open, (207) 582-5086 confirmed. RV Life 4.0 stored. Presence: koa.com page and live booking. KOA's camper rating figure didn't render as text, so unread. Reviews read are mostly good ('Pull throughs are long and level, cut into the hillside. Bathrooms and laundry are modern and clean', 5 months ago), one sharp complaint 2 years ago ('Managment has anger issues, place is riddled with mold').
SEASONAL: KOA's page sells RV sites, lodging and tent sites nightly with no seasonal offer. One reviewer 'stayed the last 3 seasons while we prepared our land', the only hint. Not mostly seasonal.

AMENITIES: koa.com's short list names only Wi-Fi, pool (5/26-9/1), propane, firewood, pavilion, dog park. Showers, laundry and a store come only from reviews ('the usual clean bathrooms, showers, laundry', 'The store was well organized'), so I didn't write them; 'MORE ABOUT AMENITIES' not opened. Dump unread.
PIN fine: stored point is on the office/lodge building, with the sites in the trees just S and E. WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' stands: no water in frame.
